AI Power Portfolio Remains Anchored on 8-inch Manufacturing — With higher
power demand for AI infrastructure, management believes discrete power
solutions will remain as the mainstream architecture for AI servers over the next
several years. While fully integrated Smart Power Stages (SPS) manufactured on
12-inch nodes are emerging, high-power AI applications continue to favor discrete

controller plus MOSFET solutions due to superior robustness. Meanwhile, VIS
continues expanding silicon carbide capabilities, targeting engineering samples in
early 2027 to address future AI data center and automotive power applications.
Reiterate Buy; TP higher to NT$185 — Anticipating improving earnings outlook
and better UTR, we lift our 2026/27 /28 earnings projection by 3%/3%/18%. We
maintain Buy with TP NT$185 (unchanged 25x PER but moving to 2027 EPS).

Vanguard International Semi.
Company description
Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation (VIS) is a specialty IC
foundry service provider, with existing capacity mainly focused on 8-inch. VIS
offers a wide range of process technologies, including high voltage, ultra-high
voltage, and BCD. In 2024, VIS and NXP Semiconductors established the
VSMC joint venture in Singapore, with its first 12-inch fab set to begin initial

production in 2027.
Investment strategy
We rate Vanguard a Buy as we expect it to benefit from robust PMIC sales
momentum, driven by strong AI demand and improving industrial demand.
VIS is gaining market share in PMIC as clients are looking for non-Chinese
suppliers. Moreover,  we believe VIS should benefit from transfer orders from
TSMC on the 8-inch wafer process. We think VIS has already passed its
trough and expect a gradual recovery into 2027.

Valuation
Our target price for VIS of NT$185 is based on 25x 2027E P/E, which we see as
justified by its robust PMIC sales growth momentum and increasing outflow
order opportunity from TSMC with support from its consistent cash dividend
policy. Our target price equates to 2026/27E P/B of 3.6x/3.5x.
Risks
Key downside risks to our target price include: 1) weaker 8-inch demand along
with higher costs due to inflation or more severe ASP competition from

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

### Page 1

M
Idea
AI server demand to stay robust next 12 months: Management sounded bullish on
component and system level AI server business into 1H27, citing strong demand
from existing customers but also new customer demand, including CSP customers.
They are broadening out to include more platforms as well, such as AMD's MI400
series platform. As a result, management sounded quite bullish on its AI server
outlook. However, we think the more important comment was on margins;

management expressed confidence that margins will continue to improve in the
coming years despite rack ASP growth, which we think implies they have negotiated
for ODM value-add based on percentage terms. We consider this is a very positive
result for the ODMs that should help drive some confidence back to the sector.
Outside of AI, demand for general server and notebook not as exciting:
Management guided for general server demand to be  flattish h/h in 2H26 and 1H27,

with growth mainly seen in the AI space. For notebook, demand appears to be even
weaker, with a 10-20% h/h decline expected for 2H26.
Other announcements: The board today approved 1) capex of NT$2B and NT$8.5B
for its Hsinchu and Kaohsiung facilities, respectively, for equipment, and NT$4B to
establish an internal AI computing center in Tainan; 2) capex of US$23M and US
$30M for Wistron InfoComm  and SMS Infocomm in Texas; and 3) the issuance of up

to 250M new common shares via GDR (up to ~7% dilution), to support AI.
Raising price target 31% to NT$275; stay OW: Our PT implies 11.8x CY27e P/E.
Valuation looks inexpensive at 8x CY27e (vs. 7-18x range past three years).

2Q26 Results Summary
Wistron 2Q OpM was 10bps above MSe and 20bps above the Street, implying Wiwynn
OpM of ~7.3%: Revenue was NT$895B (+6% q/q, +62% y/y), with GM at 5.7% (+40bps q/
q, +120bps y/y), 20bps above MSe and the Street. OpM was 3.7% (+30bps q/q, +180bps y/
y), 10bps above MSe and 20bps above the Street. Management said Wistron's core OpM
was slightly higher q/q in 2Q (1Q was ~2.05%), so we assume 2Q Wistron core OpM was
2.1-2.2%. That would imply Wiwynn's 2Q OpM was ~7.3% (above the Street at 7.0%), and

its stock could react positively as a result. Wistron's non-op loss was better than MSe, due
mainly to ~NT$2.1B of FX gains; net profit was ~NT$14.8B (+54% q/q, +128% y/y) for EPS
of NT$4.72, 26% above MSe and 30% above the Street.

Sensitivity analysis for GB300 compute tray assembly
We lay out a sensitivity analysis around potential ASPs and volumes that we could expect
from enterprise or Tier 2/Tier 3 CSP customers in 2026 and beyond for GB300 compute
tray (L10) assembly. We believe the mostly likely pricing outcomes for Wistron should be

### Page 3

M
Idea
Morgan Stanley Research 3
~US$3.0-3.2mn.
Our checks indicate that GB200 NVL72 ASP is US$3.0mn to US$3.4mn per rack (L11), and
we estimate GB300 NVL72 ASP/rack is ~20% higher than that of GB200, putting GB300
NVL72 ASP between US$3.6mn and US$4.2mn per rack (L11). We estimate compute tray
(L10) accounts for 75-85% of the entire cost of the rack, hence we view the most likely
pricing outcome for GB300 compute tray (L10) at around US$3.0-3.2mn.

Price Target and Valuation Methodology
We raise our price target (base-case value) by ~31% to NT$275; stay OW: The current
share price implies only 8.4x our 2027 EPS estimate, which we consider undervalued as
Wistron continues to shift away from low-profit consumer businesses (e.g., smartphone
EMS) to more commercial exposure (e.g., switches and servers). Our price target implies
11.8x our 2027 EPS estimate, slightly below Wistron's three-year average of 12.4x. We

think this is fair, reflecting sustainable AI server demand but some conservatism for its PC/
display business.
We continue to use a residual income model to value the stock. Our key assumptions (all
unchanged) include a cost of equity of 8.7%, medium-term growth rate of 7.0%, and
terminal growth rate of 3%.
Our bull and bear case values increase by similar magnitudes as our base case value, to
NT$390 and NT$144, respectively.

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: We provide updates after Advantech’s 2Q26 results call.

What’s the impact: 2Q26 results beat on pull-in demand. Advantech’s 
2Q26 net profit was TWD4.52bn (EPS: TWD5.2), 32% higher than our 
estimate (TWD3.42bn) and Bloomberg consensus (TWD3.43bn). 
Advantech’s 2Q26 revenue of TWD26.1bn was 15% higher than our 
estimate (TWD22.7bn) and the company’s guidance range of TWD20.5-
21bn on solid industrial demand and ongoing price hikes. Per 
management, they have seen price hikes proliferating into diversified 
components such as memory and CPU, with price increases of 10-20%. 
This caused the 2Q26 gross margin (37.7%) to be lower than its guidance 
range of 38-40% and our estimate of 39.8%. However, operating margin 
came in stronger at 19.6% (vs. our estimate of 17.7% and street’s estimate 
of 18.2%) due to better operating leverage despite a lower gross margin. 
Lastly, Advantech’s book-to-bill (B/B) ratio decreased to 1.44 in 2Q26 
(1Q26: 1.77; 4Q25: 1.33; 3Q25: 1.01).

Business update. Looking at 3Q26, management guides for sequential 
revenue growth, driven by a robust order pipeline. The 2Q26 B/B ratio of 
1.44 reflects persistent pull-in demand, particularly in the semiconductor, AI 
infrastructure and automation segments where the AI megatrend continues 
to drive industry momentum. On margins, while Advantech is passing rising 
component costs to customers, the severe price hikes limit pass-through to 
c.70%, weighing on its gross margin. Although memory shortage pressures 
are easing, PCBs, CPUs and power ICs remain in tight supply. While 
component supply is secured for 3Q26, supply visibility for 4Q26 remains 
uncertain, posing a risk to gross margin. Accordingly, we estimate the gross 
margin to be c.37-38% in 2H26 but believe Advantech's operating leverage 
will compensate for the pressure. Edge AI revenue mix expanded to 22.5% 
in 1H26 from 15% in 2025, which is partly attributable to chip-level AI-
embedded design upgrades across the latest generations. Management 
remains constructive on the edge AI growth trajectory, and we view the 
rising mix as a key long-term catalyst.

What we recommend: We raise our 2026-28E EPS by 32% to reflect 
Advantech’s 2Q26 results. We reaffirm our Outperform (2) call and raise 
our 12M TP to TWD700 (from TWD480), based on an unchanged PER of 
30x (high end of its past-3-year range of 20-37x), considering its historical 
up-cycle PER range of 30-37x and applied to our 1-year forward EPS. Key 
downside risk: slower-than-expected demand recovery.

How we differ: Our 2026-28E EPS are 17-29% above consensus, likely 
due to our more bullish outlook on Advantech’s revenue.

5 August 2026

2Q26 results: Near-term momentum intact

➢ Sequential revenue growth in 3Q26, backed by secured components 
➢ Component price hike pressure on 2H26 margins 
➢ Reaffirming our Outperform (2) rating; raising 12-month TP to TWD700

Company profile 
Founded in 1981 and listed in 1999, Advantech is the largest industrial PC (IPC) maker worldwide in 
terms of embedded board/system sales, followed by the company’s main competitors, Germany-based 
Kontron and US-based Radisys. The company mainly provides embedded computing boards, chassis, 
industrial computers, applied computers and design-in services. The businesses are categorised into 4 
segments: Embedded design-in, Industrial IoT, Service IoT, and Global services.

AT&S doesn’t rule out the potential of receiving more rush orders, which they believe will
lead to potential upside to current guidance on revenue/profitability. We think AT&S’

commentary is consistent with the industry supply shortages we have observed (see
here) and is in line with our key Buy thesis on NYPCB (see here), who will continue to
benefit from a better pricing outlook with an 8/34/51% S/D gap in 2026/27/28 per GSe.
Moreover, we continue to see more customers asking Taiwan ABF suppliers for ABF
substrate capacity beyond 2029. Meanwhile, AT&S mentioned that customers are
securing long-term capacity through prepayments (AT&S’ Kulim 1.0 & 2.0 is fully booked

by clients), which we see as in line with the overall industry trend.
The upward revision for AT&S’ FY26/27 revenue guidance, along with the higher EBITDA
margin outlook of 32-37% (equivalent to GM at 41-46%), is in line with the industry
trend of customers securing AI-related substrates supply through long-term
agreements, with AI-related substrate products typically having higher prices and better
GM (at 50%+ vs. AT&S’ substrates business GM at 30%+ in FY1Q26/27). Based on

historical data, Taiwan ABF suppliers typically have GM higher than AT&S during
upcycles. Our current estimates for Taiwan ABF suppliers’ 2Q26-1Q27 GM is 35/30/29%
for NYPCB/Kinsus/Unimicron, which are below the AT&S FY26/27 GM guidance of
41-46%, thus we see further upside potential to our Taiwan ABF suppliers’ margin
forecast (Exhibit 1).
Overall, we continue to believe ABF substrate pricing uptrend has already started in
1H26, and we should see further acceleration in ABF substrate pricing given the

shortage conditions, leading to a favorable profitability outlook over the coming
quarters/years. Moreover, we continue to expect the S/D gap for ABF substrates to
widen from an 8% undersupply in 2026 to 34/51% in 2027/28.
Maintain our Buy rating on NYPCB (on CL) and Kinsus and maintain our 12m TP at
NT$2,310/NT$1,125, but stay Neutral on Unimicron and maintain our 12m TP at
NT$1,220.

### Page 5

Investment Thesis & PT methodology and risks

Investment Thesis - NYPCB 
NYPCB manufactures and markets printed circuit boards (PCBs) and integrated circuit 
(IC) substrates (including ABF and BT substrates). We are Buy-rated on NYPCB 
considering the company’s high exposure to BT substrates and non-LTA ABF substrate 
(70%+ of total revenue), where we expect GM/OPM to increase significantly in the 
coming quarters (from breakeven in OPM in 1H25 to 27/41% in 2026/27E) due to the 
favorable substrate pricing outlook. Despite the company’s low exposure to high-end 
ABF substrate industry (<20% of total revenue in 1H25), we believe the expanding 
demand from ASIC AI server and high-end switch IC demand will drive the company’s 
high-end ABF revenue exposure to 40%+ by 2027E, suggesting better GM/OPM outlook 
in the long term. In 2H25-2H26, we believe NYPCB will continue to benefit from stronger 
ABF/BT pricing and should be a key beneficiary of the pricing uptrend considering the 
company’s key focus on BT and non-LTA ABF substrate industries. Moreover, in the long 
term (after 2026), we expect the ABF industry to return to supply tightness, and NYPCB’s 
expanding high-end exposure will lead to a long term earnings growth outlook (122% 
2026-28E earnings CAGR). As a result, we see solid upside potential for NYPCB’s 
earnings and stock performance.  
Price Target Risks and Methodology - NYPCB 
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$2,310 for NYPCB is based 
on 21x 2028 P/E, which is +1.5x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E (13.3x).  
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2) 
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, and (3) 
Slower-than-expected NYPCB new high-end capacity qualification progress.

### Page 6

Investment Thesis - Kinsus
Kinsus is one of the key IC substrates suppliers globally with ~10% ABF/BT substrates
market share in 2024, with ~18% of total 2025 revenue contributed by its contact lens
subsidiary, Pegavision (6941.TW, Not Covered). With our view that the ABF substrate
shortage started from 2Q26 (ABF substrate return to supply demand balance from late
2025), we believe Kinsus’ performance will continue to improve compared with high-end

ABF peers considering the company’s increasing market share in the high-end ABF
substrate market; however, ~36% of the company’s revenue was contributed by BT
substrates in 2025 and 30% of the company’s ABF revenue is from non-LTA customers,
which we believe will continue to enjoy a better pricing outlook. As a result, we believe
Kinsus’ earnings outlook should continue to be strong (~106% 2026-29E CAGR), mainly
driven by better BT substrate and non-LTA ABF substrate pricing outlook, despite the

unfavorable demand outlook before 2H26. We believe Kinsus is an experienced
substrate supplier with a clear capacity expansion plan that can also upgrade its product
portfolio in the long term. We believe we are at the beginning of an industry upcycle,
making us positive on Kinsus’ stock performance over the next 12 months.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - Kinsus
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$1,125 for Kinsus is based on

16.5x 2028E P/E, which is +1.2x STDV higher than Kinsus’ past upcycle average P/E
(14.2x).
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, (3)
Slower/Less-than-expected AI server orders from 2H26.
Investment Thesis - Unimicron Technology
Unimicron is a key supplier of ABF substrates (25% market share in 2025) and BT
substrates and also produces FPC/HDI/PCB products. We are Neutral rated on the

shares given long-term growth opportunity prospects: (1) over 70% of ABF shipments
are covered by long-term agreements (LTA), which limits pricing flexibility and makes
price hike less likely; (2) the company’s execution track record has been weaker than
peers; (3) capacity expansion plan remains slower than peers, constraining its ability to
capture incremental AI demand. The current ABF substrates market is seeing more
favorable supply demand outlook, and Unimicron is likely to see better pricing outlook

to reflect rising material costs in the coming quarters. AI ABF account for 10% of the
company’s total revenue, but the growth is likely to be slower than peers due to the
company continuing to lose market share to peers given its less favourable production
yield and slow capacity expansion. Overall, we are Neutral rated on Unimicron given our
outlook for the limited upside potential, barring ASIC AI servers, despite our generally
positive view on the long term on profitability trajectory.

Price Target Risks and Methodology - Unimicron Technology
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$1,220 for Unimicron is
based on 17.4x 2028E P/E, which is 2.7x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E
(10.3x).
Key upside/downside risks: (1) Slower/faster-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower/faster-than-expected ABF substrates upgrading pace, and (3) Slower/faster

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.

Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Bizlink  | Asia Pacific
July Sales  +13% MoM/+60%
YoY
In this report, we focus on Bizlink's monthly sales, which we
believe could be a catalyst for its share price.
Details:
• July sales came in at NT$9,630mn (+13% MoM/+60% YoY).
• QTD reached 38% of both our 3Q26 estimate of NT$25,120mn (+8% QoQ/
+36% YoY) and consensus at NT$25,323mn (+9% QoQ/+38% YoY).
Our view:
• We think its 3Q26 revenue is tracking ahead of market expectations.
• Looking into 2H26, we expect Bizlink to see strong demand in the HPC

segment, driven by the new ASIC server model ramp and continuous AI/
general server momentum, before witnessing more dollar content upgrade
heading into 2027.
• We remain constructive on Bizlink as an AI beneficiary, driven by its data
interconnect, power interconnect, and semiconductor equipment businesses.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Bizlink (3665.TW)
Base case, derived from 30x 2027e P/E. We think our target P/E multiple is justified by an
earnings CAGR of 46% seen over 2025-28e, which implies a PEG of around 0.7. This is in-line
with the average of 0.7 in 2019-24, when the stock was trading at an average 13x P/E for a 19%
earnings CAGR.
Risks to Upside
n Faster and wider AEC adoption
n Data center and semi equipment capex increases that drive stronger HPC and semi-cap

business
n Stronger recovery for automotive business
Risks to Downside
n Lower-than-expected AEC adoption
n Intensifying competition
n Softer-than-expected AI capex
n Slower-than-expected growth in the semi capital equipment market
n Continued weakness in the auto industry

going well: MPI reported strong 2Q preliminary revenue up 33% Q/Q, 6% above

strong AI demand to sustain this momentum. We see a price hike across all product
lines driving 3Q revenue, with margin reaching ~60% amid relatively less CPC
exposure. Our checks indicate that none of MPI's equipment has been disqualified in

the insertion test flow, with insertion 3 prober on track to ship in 4Q and insertion 2
likely to start in mid-27. MPI will host an on-site earnings call on August 14, with key
focus on the MEMS probe pin capacity expansion plan, CPO progress and revenue
targets, and key AI GPU/ASIC market shares.
Winway – 3Q revenue seen topping 20% Q/Q, with 2H margin likely to recover
to 43-45%: Although 2Q preliminary revenue tracked in line with expectations, GM

was likely below 40%, potentially from a higher smartphone (plastic socket) mix; we
monitor demand from low-cost models, stronger MEMS probe card contributions,
and writing off defective products during the new capacity ramp. As all new capacity
comes online, We expect Winway to fulfill all backlog into year-end, with stable
yield and a better product mix in sockets and probe cards stabilizing 2H GM at 43-
45%. Winway plans to release earnings on 6 Aug after the market close.

Raising MPI PT to NT$8,000, cutting Winway to NT$12,000: We increase our MPI

from 16.4%, to reflect unstable GM; our new PT implies 58x 2027e EPS (currently

Details of MPI Business Development
Capacity
With a view toward meeting strong demand from customers, MPI intends to further
increase its capacity substantially into 2026-27, in particular for MEMS probe cards. Its
plan was to expand its VPC capacity from 1.2mn pins per month to 1.5mn in 2Q26,  and it
expects a further increase to 2mn per month in 4Q26. For MEMS, the company plans to
expand capacity from 2.0mn pins per month to 2.5mn in 2Q26 and 3.5mn in 4Q26, which

should help it  further expand share in that market. Looking to 2027, management expects
MPI to expand total VPC and MEMS capacity by 60% to around 8.8mn pins per month,
with MEMS expansion magnitude outpacing VPC. However, with more new facilities and
land purchased recently, we do not rule out its MEMS capacity reaching 8-10mn pins per
month, with our bull case extending beyond 10mn.
Order visibility and contract liabilities vs. revenue
Management said during the most recent earnings call said that it expects its B/B ratio for

all product lines to stay above 1 during 2026. Currently, order visibility for MPI has
stretched from one quarter (historical average) to nine months. Additionally, contract
liabilities rose 44% QoQ and 58% YoY in 1Q26, reaching 59% of revenue, indicating
aggressive pre-payments from customers and helping to solidify future revenue streams.

expansion.

insertion test flow, with insertion 3 prober on track to ship in 4Q and insertion 2 likely to

MPI: Estimate Revisions and Financials
We lift our EPS estimates, factoring in stronger-than-expected 2Q26 revenue and 2H26
guidance. We expect the ongoing ramp of AI ASIC such as Trainium and networking, strong
momentum in traditional non-AI business such as DDIC, and newly gained non-AI ASIC
customers to continue bear fruit in the near term. CPO equipment shipment should start
shipping in 2H26, with the newly purchased fab targeting CPO equipment production

helping to sustain growth momentum into 2027-28. The GM increase is seen driven mainly
by more shipments of MEMS probe cards as well as the price hike conducted across probe
card product lines starting 3Q26.

MPI: Valuation Methodology
We lift our price target from NT$7,500 to NT$8,000: This factors in our 2026-28
estimate increases and a slightly decrease in the payout ratio from 75% to 67% for R&D

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.
Unless otherwise specified, the time frame for price targets included in Morgan Stanley Research is 12 to 18 months.
Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.
Benchmarks for each region are as follows: North America - S&P 500; Latin America - relevant MSCI country index or MSCI Latin America Index; Europe - MSCI Europe; Japan - TOPIX; Asia -

Chroma ATE
Valuation
Our target price of NT$2,500 is based on 40x 2027E P/E, at close to 1x PEG. Chroma shares have re-rated above its historical
range as its growth outlook is now strongly tied to AI infrastructure build out. We estimate 60%+ of its revenue are now AI-
related, with strong growth across product segments including power testers, SLT, metrology, and photonics. Chroma has a
commanding market share in most of these segments and well positioned to capitalized on the global AI expansion.

Risks
Downside risks to our target price include: 1) softer AI/CPO growth expectation due to changes in capex outlook or production
bottleneck; 2) fewer SLT needed as a result of shortened cycle time as GPU yield rate improves; 3) disappointing metrology
shipment due to changes at ramp-up schedule; 4) testing process change leading to loss in market share; 5) FX risks (50-60%
of Chroma’s sales are in US$, 10-20% in Rmb).

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

### Page 1

Summary: SDI reported its 2Q26 results after market hours on 6 August. Its 2Q26 EPS 
was TWD1.60, missing our EPS estimate (TWD1.69) but beating the Bloomberg 
consensus (TWD1.42). The company will hold an investor call tomorrow (7 August) and we 
will provide an update thereafter.

We have a Buy (1) rating on SDI with a 12-month TP of TWD265, based on a PER of 39x 
on our 1-year-forward EPS. For more information on the company, please refer to our 
latest memo, Record-high 2Q26 revenue beat expectations, on 9 July 2026.

What’s the impact 
• 2Q26 results beat consensus. SDI’s 2Q26 revenue of TWD3,559m (+26.9% QoQ, 
+37.2% YoY) beat our and the consensus estimates by 4.0% and 4.1%, mainly due to 
the better-than-expected auto segment and rush orders for the consumer segment. Its 
gross margin came in at 20.7% in 2Q26, higher than 19.1% in 1Q26 and 10.5% in 
2Q25, also beating both our (19.5%) and the consensus (18.8%) estimates, which we 
attribute to a higher utilisation rate and efficiency, as well as previous price hikes in 
1H26. With higher personnel costs, its operating profit of TWD417m (+53.4% QoQ, 
+486.2% YoY) was in line with our estimate, but beat the consensus estimate by 15.1%. 
Its net profit came in at TWD303m, also in line with our estimate (TWD307m) but 
beating the Bloomberg consensus (TWD273m) estimate. Its 2Q26 EPS was TWD1.60. 
For 2Q26 revenue, electronics accounted for 90% (+28.0% QoQ, +41.5% YoY) and 
stationery accounted for 10% (+9.4% QoQ, -3.3% YoY). Within electronics, the product 
mix was: auto 47% (+25.4% QoQ, +33.0% YoY), industrial 15% (+20.0% QoQ, -3.5% 
YoY), consumer 30% (+37.2% QoQ, +63.3% YoY), AI lead frame 6% (+28.0% QoQ) and 
others 2% (+28.0% QoQ, +41.5% YoY).

• Bright lead frame outlook with rising AI lead frame and heat spreader. The 
company expects its 2H26 revenue to grow by a high-single-digit % HoH. Its AI lead 
frame accounted for 6% of revenue in 2Q26, and management targets to reach double-
digit revenue contribution by 4Q26. SDI highlights that it has received many rush orders 
for AI lead frames, and 50-60 new AI-related products are expected to be launched in 
2H26.

Status: ok

### Page 1

WT Microelectronics

Speed bump in datacenter growth in 3Q26 
but followed by reacceleration afterward

Reiterate Rating: BUY | PO: 330.00 TWD | Price: 233.50 TWD

2Q ahead on op-leverage; better GM in 3Q on mix 
2Q26 net income of NT$9.7bn (EPS of NT$7.7) was 23%/18% ahead of 
BofAe/consensus, thanks partly to the stronger-than-expected operating leverage. 
Management further stated that GM (gross margin) held up at 3.4% in 2Q26, thanks to 
the demand strength from auto/industrial applications. Looking into 3Q26, revenue is 
guided to be flat QoQ per the mid-point of the guidance range, due mainly to the 
tapered momentum in datacenter business. Therefore, GM is expected to tick up QoQ 
given a better mix in 3Q26. 
Expect datacenter growth to resume from 4Q26 
Beyond 3Q26, WT Micro states that the growth of datacenter business should 
reaccelerate in 4Q26 and 2027, while it notes that the B/B (book-to-bill) ratio for 
auto/industrial business is above 1 currently. In other words, the firm shares the view 
that demand growth in AI (artificial intelligence) applications will sustain, and the growth 
will likely extend to other non-AI areas for WT Micro.  
See boosts from chip inflation; reit. Buy 
In the longer term, the company intends to focus more on its data centre and 
communications businesses, which should enable it to outgrow its industry peers. As a 
result, we reiterate our Buy rating. Elsewhere, the company has not seen any meaningful 
impact from tariffs so far. In addition, cost inflation across the semiconductor supply 
chain is expected to provide a modest boost to revenue growth while offering stronger 
support for operating leverage.  
Raise PO to NT$330 same based on 10x P/E 
We raise our target price to NT$330 (from NT$310), based on an unchanged 10x 2H27-
1H28E P/E multiple. We also increase our 2026-28E EPS forecasts by 7-11% to reflect 
the stronger-than-expected 2Q26 results and our updated outlook going forward.

Company Sector 
Semiconductors

Company Description 
WT Microelectronics was founded in 1993 and went listed 
in 2002. The firm is the biggest distributor for 
semiconductor and technology hardware components 
globally with 10+% market share, and with more than 25k 
customers and over 400 suppliers. WT Micro operates in 
dual-headquarter business model, after acquiring Future 
Electronics in 2024, and now it has over eight thousand 
employees with over 160 sales branches.

Investment Rationale 
We have a Buy rating on WT Micro, as we like the structural 
growth in datacenter business mainly driven by TPU, as well 
as the emerging benefits/synergies from the cross-selling 
with Future Electronics.

### Page 5

Price objective basis & risk 
WT Microelectronics (XZOPF) 
We base our PO NT$330 on 10x 2H27-1H28E P/E, which is at the mid-end of its 
historical trading range of 4-15x. This is justified in our view, given the support from: 1) 
an operating margin of 2.2% in 2027-28E, 2) improving ROE toward 32% in 2027-28E 
(vs 12% in 2024-25), and 3) 20% EPS CAGR during 2026-28E.

Upside risks to our PO are: 
1) faster-than-expected demand recovery in auto/industrial verticals, especially from 
US/Europe market 
2) a lower interest rate that could alleviate the company's financial burden at non-
operating level.

Downside risks to our PO are: 
1) a revenue decline in datacenter/server related business, which has been the key 
growth driver during 2021-24 
2) market share loss as suppliers or customers seek other distributors' help after WT 
Micro consolidates Future Electronics. 
3) Potential overhang from share dilution.

Idea
2Q26 OP above consensus: On the back of revenue at NT$95,538mn (+36% QoQ/
+58% YoY), GM expanded by 0.1ppt QoQ to 19.7% (vs. MSe of 20.2%/consensus of
19.2%) as tailwinds from a favorable product mix were largely offset by higher
component costs. With opex better controlled at NT$4,491mn (opex ratio 4.7% vs.
MSe 5.0%/consensus 4.3%), OP was NT$14,323mn (OPM 15.0%), 4%/9% higher than
MSe of NT$13,740mn (OPM 15.2%)/consensus of NT$13,083mn (OPM 14.9%),

respectively. Helped by non-op gains of NT$245mn, NP came in at NT$11,053mn
(EPS NT$19.78), 2%/6% higher than MSe/consensus of NT$10,815mn (EPS NT
$19.35)/NT$10,421mn (EPS NT$18.68).
Revenue momentum sustained into 3Q26: Off the strong revenues in 2Q26, we
expect Accton to continue growing sequentially into 3Q26 as it should benefit from
broader-based  migration to 800G network switches from both existing and new
customers.  Moreover, the ramp of the new AI accelerator model  from its major

customer should be in full swing. Judging from July monthly sales of NT$39,473 (flat
MoM/+72% YoY), we expect 3Q26 revenue to grow by +27% QoQ/+66% YoY to NT
$120,883mn. On the margin side, as elevated component costs linger amid tight
supply and its revenue mix could turn less favorable in 2H26, we expect GM to
contract slightly to 18.5% (-1.2ppt QoQ). Nonetheless, operating leverage could help
mitigate the margin pressure and hold operating margin at 14.2% (-0.8ppt QoQ).

Stay OW: We remain constructive on Accton as we think its is well positioned in the
AI capex cycle to benefit from networking and compute deployment. Furthermore, it
should not miss out on opportunities in rack level solutions, optical-based switches,
etc. We maintain OW with a PT of NT$3,500 (30x 2027 P/E).

Valuation Methodology and Risks
OW with PT of NT$3,500 (previously NT$3,800)
Price target (base case scenario value) –  NT$3,500 (-8%): Our new price target is based
on 30x our 2027 EPS estimate (33x previously). We lower our target multiple to factor in
recent market sentiment toward AI names. We see our target multiple supported by the
48% operating profit CAGR we project for 2025-28. This implies a PEG of 0.6 vs. its
average of 0.7 over 2019-25, when the stock was trading at a P/E of 22x for an operating

profit CAGR of 32%.
Bull case scenario value – NT$4,200 (-3%): We apply 36x to our base case EPS estimate
for 2027 (38x previously). This scenario reflects stronger demand for network switches in
both data center and enterprise applications as well as more orders for AI accelerator
modules.
Bear case scenario value – NT$1,800 (-8%): We apply 16x to our base case EPS estimate
for 2027 (17x previously). This scenario reflects lukewarm data center and enterprise

capex and continued dominance by merchant GPUs in AI servers.
Downside risks to our positive thesis
• Weaker data center capex
• Slower network switch spec migration
• InfiniBand taking more share in AI networks
• Softer custom AI accelerator growth
• Softer ODM direct business model adoptions

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.
Unless otherwise specified, the time frame for price targets included in Morgan Stanley Research is 12 to 18 months.
Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Update
Novatek  | Asia Pacific
3Q Revenue Growth Led by
Smartphones
2Q results beat: Revenue rose 24% Q/Q, mainly from early pull-in demand, with
SoC now 50% of total revenue. The GM increased 3.4ppt Q/Q, to 42.4%, supported
by price increases, favorable mix and low-cost inventory.
3Q revenue up 4.7-11.7% Q/Q; margin slightly lower at 38.5-41.5%: Management
expects smartphone demand to grow significantly in 3Q, as Apple demand remains
resilient. SoC revenue should be flat Q/Q, as machine vision edge AI demand offsets

LDDI-related SoC weakness. LDDI will  decline Q/Q owing to weaker demand and
panel makers' decreasing production. GM may decline with an unfavorable mix, but
Novatek will likely raise prices again to reflect the cost burden. The OpM will be 19-
20%.
Highlights from today's call:
• Auto: Expects strong Y/Y growth given share gain.
• Foundry/OSAT price hike: Continues to see elevated upstream costs into
2027, passing them through to customers or optimizing design.

Stay UW: We expect the GM to remain resilient at current levels, but valuation is
full  at 15x 2027e EPS, while the company's exposure to AI is limited.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Novatek (3034.TW)
Base case, residual income model. Key assumptions: cost of equity constant at 9.8% (2.0%
risk-free rate, 6% risk premium, 1.3 beta), payout ratio of 80%, medium-term growth rate of
6.1% and terminal growth rate assumption of 3.4%.
Risks to Upside
n Faster-than-expected 8K/4K TV growth.
n Better-than-expected smartphone sell-through.
n Better-than-expected sell-through of foldable products.

Risks to Downside
n Intensified price competition in TDDI, driving Novatek's gross margin below its corpo-
rate average.
n Slower-than-expected 8K/4K TV growth.
n Slower sell-through of foldable products.

### Page 1

ab 6 August 2026
Global Research
ASPEED Technology Inc
AI winner story unchanged; bright outlook in
2027
Strong Q2 GM driven by price increase; Q3 to beat guidance
Aspeed reported Q2 GM of 72.0%, above consensus and UBSe of 69.3%/69.4%. We
believe this is mainly from the April price adjustment. Looking ahead, we estimate Q3
GM at 69.4%, slightly above guidance of 67-68%. With resilient Cloud AI demand and
improving supply of BT substrate and backend into H226, we forecast Aspeed's Q3 sales

to be NT$4.49bn, up 16% QoQ , outperforming the company guidance of NT$4.1-
4.3bn. For the entire year, we now estimate Aspeed to ship 31.0m BMCs (or up 63%
YoY) in 2026E, up slightly from our prior estimate of 30.8m. For 2027, we see further
growth potential for Aspeed's BMC shipment to reach 44.6m BMCs, a 44% YoY
growth, underpinned by CPU, GPU and ASIC servers across the US and China.
Initial 2027 orders tracking healthily with better product mix

Looking ahead into 2027E, we think the supply situation should further improve for
Aspeed. 1) Most of AST2700 shipment in 2027 should be using E-glass based BT
substrate, and 2) second qualified OSAT partner to enable steadier capacity support for
growing demand across both AI and general servers. Product mix wise, AST2700's mix is
on track to pick up meaningfully in 2027E, and should reach 26% of total shipment for
the year, generating a better blended ASP profile with AST2700's US$22-25 pricing,

above that of AST2600's cUS$16. As for the latest product developments: 1) the new
SMC 1840 with integrated FPGA is on track to start meaningful shipment by year-end
2027E and will contribute to sales in 2028E. 2) The new standalone SMC with Caliptra
integrated, the AST1040, with higher ASP (around US$10 vs current product of US$6.5-
7) should be shipping from late 2026E to improve SMC ASP in 2027E.
Strength across AI and general server unchallenged

As we have elaborated in our prior report, structurally, we continue to view Aspeed as a
key beneficiary of the rising agentic AI and server CPU opportunity. We forecast BMC
unit TAM for compute board to reach 77m in 2030E from 21m in 2025, with a further
10%+ upside risk from switches and storages.  See Figure 1S e r v e r s '  B M C  T A M  a n a l y s i s for our TAM analysis. Into
2027, the company should  solidify its lead across its current customer base, and we

believe Nvidia's Rubin Ultra is on track to use the 2700 series BMCs, signaling better
blended product and pricing structure of BMCs for GPU servers, on top of growth from
general and ASIC servers.
Valuation: Reiterate Buy and maintain our price target of NT$22,000
We raise net profit estimates by 4%/9%/11% for 2026E/27E/28E , respectively.
However, our EPS estimates for 2026E and beyond are largely unchanged, after
factoring in the 10% higher share count effective this quarter. Our price target is based

on a 55x average 2027-28E PE and a long-term earnings CAGR of 34%.

Company Description
ASPEED is the world's largest baseboard management controller (BMC) chipset provider.
ASPEED introduced the first generation of server management processors in 2005. It acquired
Emulex Pilot's remote server management chip business in 2016. Besides server management

chipsets, ASPEED also produces PC/AV extension solutions and image processing system-on-
chips (SoCs). In 2023, server management chipsets accounted for 88% of total sales.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We derive our price target for Aspeed from PE valuation methodology relative to its historical
trading range.
We believe key upside risks for Aspeed include: 1) stronger-than-expected server demand,
particularly from hyperscalers and from AI servers with less crowding out of traditional

servers; 2) further market share expansion; 3) faster-than-expected server platform upgrades;
4) faster-than-expected progress in expanding the addressable content within servers.
We believe key downside risks for Aspeed include: 1) weaker-than-expected server demand,
particularly from hyperscalers; 2) market share losses or more intense industry competition; 3)
slower-than-expected server platform upgrades; 4) slower-than-expected progress in
expanding the addressable content within servers.

Investing in structured investments involves significant risks. For a detailed discussion of the risks involved in investing in any particular structured investment, you must read

the relevant offering materials for that investment. Structured investments are unsecured obligations of a particular issuer with returns linked to the performance of an
underlying asset. Depending on the terms of the investment, investors could lose all or a substantial portion of their investment based on the performance of the underlying
asset. Investors could also lose their entire investment if the issuer becomes insolvent. UBS does not guarantee in any way the obligations or the financial condition of any

issuer or the accuracy of any financial information provided by any issuer. Structured investments are not traditional investments and investing in a structured investment is
not equivalent to investing directly in the underlying asset. Structured investments may have limited or no liquidity, and investors should be prepared to hold their investment
to maturity. The return of structured investments may be limited by a maximum gain, participation rate or other feature. Structured investments may include call features and,

### Page 1

Giant (9921.TW)
Margins Reset Higher as Fundamentals Turn; Upgrade to Buy, TP 
NT$108
CITI'S TAKE 
We upgrade Ginat to Buy following a substantial 2Q earnings beat driven by 
stronger-than-expected margin improvement. We believe the margin 
recovery is sustainable, supported by new products ramp-ups, a richer OB 
mix, and improving demand from EU and China. Mgmt’s FY26 guidance – 
LSD sales decline, 20-21% GPM, 1-3% OPM – appears conservative given 
the 22.3% GPM achieved in 1H and improving regional trends. We raise our 
26-28E EPS by 11-12% and lift TP to NT$108 based on 18.5x NTM P/E. With 
channel inventory lean, demand gradually recovering and earnings visibility 
improving, we believe the worst is behind and see an attractive risk/reward. 
Upgrade to Buy – margin resilience creates earnings upsides — We upgrade Giant 
from Neutral to Buy as the key concerns underpinning our previous cautious view are 
beginning to ease. The substantial 2Q margin beat demonstrates that product mix 
improvement and new model launches can more than offset still-elevated operating 
expenses. We expect margins to remain at relatively high levels in 2H26E, supported 
by continued new product ramp-ups, and improving fundamentals in EU and China.
2Q26 results significantly exceeded expectations on margin expansion — 
Revenue rose 6% y/y to NT$16.7bn, beating our/BBG est by 6%/5% each. GPM 
expanded 3.8ppt y/y to 24.2%, higher than our/BBG, driven by a higher own-brand 
contribution, product mix optimization and strong sales of newly launched models. 
Despite opex rising 0.5ppy y/y, reflecting product launch, sports sponsorship, and 
WRO-related legal expenses, OPM improved to 6.0% from 2.8% in 2Q25. Net profits 
were NT$635mn (+234% y/y), beating our/BBG est by 147%/48% each. 
Improving fundamentals yet mgmt. guidance still looks conservative — Mgmt. 
expects FY26E sales to decline by LSD y/y with GPM of 20-21% and OPM of 1-3%. 
We see ample upside to this guidance particularly after GPM reached 22.3% in 1H26. 
EU sales grew in teens y/y in 2Q, supported by successful new model launches, while 
China also returned to teens growth amid improving demand and healthier channel 
inventory. Giant expects new OB models to sustain EU growth in 2H despite soft OE 
demand while China should maintain stable momentum. Although the pace of the 
industry recovery remains gradual, we believe lean channel inventories and 
improving sell-through suggest that the downcycle has passed its trough.

Giant
Company description
Giant was founded in 1972 as an OEM manufacturer initially and established
its own brand in 1981, first marketed in Taiwan followed by Europe, North
America, and other markets. Giant is now the world’s largest bicycle
manufacturer with a roughly 4% global market share in terms of unit sales and
is also among the world’s largest brands. The company is the primary contract
manufacturer for the world’s largest brand, Trek, and it is the largest brand

among high-end bikes in China. Following Trek, Giant brand bikes rank
among the T op 3 in the US.
Investment strategy
We have a Buy rating on the shares. Giant's strong 2Q beat, driven by
substantial margin improvement, points to meaningful upside to our and
BBG estimates. We expect margins to remain at elevated levels in 2H26E,
supported by new products ramp-ups and improving fundamentals in EU and
China where sales grew in the teens in 2Q26.With channel inventories lean

and demand gradually recovering, we believe worst is behind.
Valuation
Our target price for Giant of NT$108 is based on a 2H26-1H27E P/E of 18.5x,
setting at the mid circle of the stock's historical range of 14-30x during pre-
Covid years (2014-2019).
Risks
Downside/upside risks that could cause the Giant shares to deviate from our
target price: 1) e-bike adoption being slower/faster than expected; 2)
prolonged negative/positive impact from inventory correction, 3) China

domestic demand turning weak/strengthening; and 4) supply chain
disruption from shipping issues.
If the impact on the company from any of these factors differs from our base
case expectations, the stock could have difficulty achieving our target price or
could increase more than we expect.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval

### Page 1

Taiwan Industrials

What’s new: Sunon posted its 2Q26 results today (7 August). We reaffirm 
our Buy (1) call as we expect the outlook for its telecom, servers, and 
industrial segments in 2026 to remain intact with both gross and operating 
margin set to expand.

What’s the impact: 2Q26 results largely in line with estimates; record-
high monthly revenue in July. Sunon’s 2Q26 revenue of TWD5,419m 
(+8.0% QoQ and +16.2% YoY) was in line with our and the consensus 
estimates. Its 2Q26 gross margin came in at 31.3% (vs. 31.7% in 1Q26 and 
30.5% in 2Q25), slightly missing our and the consensus estimates of 31.8% 
due to rising raw material costs. Therefore, its operating profit of TWD836m 
(+6.1% QoQ and +16.9% YoY) missed our and the consensus estimates by 
6.4% and 6.7%, respectively, after factoring in higher-than-expected admin. 
expenses. Its operating margin of 15.4% (vs. 15.7% in 1Q26 and 15.3% in 
2Q25) also missed our estimate of 16.6% and the consensus estimate of 
16.5%. With some non-op gains, its net profit of TWD690m (+6.3% QoQ 
and +84.5% YoY) was largely in line with our and the consensus estimates. 
Its 2Q26 EPS finished at TWD2.42, also largely in line with our (TWD2.39) 
estimate and the consensus (TWD2.49) estimates. On 5 August, Sunon 
reported a record-high monthly revenue for July of TWD2,119m (+14.2% 
QoQ, +31.7% YoY; +20.3% YoY for 7M26), accounting for 37.8% and 
36.4% of our previous and the consensus estimates, mainly due to the 
shipments of ASIC projects.

Solid revenue momentum likely to continue into 2H26. For 2H26, we 
expect its revenue to grow QoQ in light of ASIC projects that are expected 
to be launched. For its liquid cooling revenue, Sunon expects a single-
digit % revenue contribution in 2026, and intends to tap into enterprise, 
GPU, and ASIC clients. We raise our 2026-28E EPS by 2-5%, mainly on 
higher revenue assumptions.

What we recommend: We reaffirm our Buy (1) call and raise our 12M TP 
to TWD205 (from TWD200), now based on a target PER of 17x applied to 
our 1-year forward EPS forecast. Still around the midpoint of its past-5-year 
range of 7-25x, the target PER is slightly lower than 18x previously as we 
now forecast a net profit CAGR of 17.2% (previously 18.1%) over 2026-
28E (1x PEG). Downside risks: worse-than-expected gross-margin 
expansion and AI server development progress.

How we differ: We are one of only two overseas brokers covering the 
stock. Our 2028E EPS is 2% above the Bloomberg consensus, likely due to 
our higher revenue estimate.

7 August 2026

2Q26 results review: largely in line with estimates

➢ 2Q26 net profit in line with estimates; July revenue ahead of estimates 
➢ Strong 2026 outlook, driven by telecom, server, and industrial 
➢ Reaffirming our Buy (1) call; raising our 12-month TP to TWD205

Company profile 
Founded in 1980 and listed on Taiwan’s main board in 2000, Sunonwealth Electric Machine Industry 
(Sunon) is one of the top-4 fan and motor providers in the world, along with Delta Electronics, Nidec and 
ebm-papst. Its major clients are Apple, Dell, Lenovo, Bosch, Siemens and Tesla. Its applications include 
IT & OE, telecoms & servers, industrial & medical equipment, home applications, distribution, autos and 
LED lighting.

Wiwynn
Valuation
Our target price for Wiwynn is NT$9,500. We value Wiwynn based on PE as we believe the company’s earnings performance
and industry dynamics will be the key focus areas for the market. Our TP is based on 18x 2027E EPS, which is at the top end of
the historical trading range since listing and above the average PE multiple of the peer group. We believe our target multiple is
justified by the company’s 100% exposure to data centers, rising scale, and robust earnings growth, as well as stabilizing ROE.

Risks
Key downside risks that could cause Wiwynn’s shares to trade below our target price include: 1) Potential volatility in capex
deployment; 2) Component price hike; 3) Peer competition; and 4) FX volatility.

Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

upcoming new projects (+99% q/q), so OP came in at NT$20.2bn (+23% q/q,

q/q), while showing 70bps beat vs. our prior estimate and 30bps above the

Street, but we view it as in line because Wistron had already reported a few
days earlier and we were able to back out Wiwynn's OpM at ~7.3% already,
which we mentioned in our Wistron report here.
• Non-op losses also higher than expected, mainly owing to higher interest
expenses.

below MSe but in line with the Street.

Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

3605 宏致(ACES)

報告日期： 2026/08/06  研 究 員：洪瑞陽  (Ryan Hung) 
壹、投 資 建 議

一、 2Q26 營收 33.5 億元，預估稅後 EPS 1.27 元 
2Q26 合併營收  33.5 億元， QoQ +18.8% 、YoY +20.2% ，創同期
歷史新高。三率同步改善 ： 毛利率 26.3% （QoQ +1.7ppts 、YoY 約
持平） 、營業利益率 7.65% （QoQ +2.4ppts ） 、稅後淨利率 6.2% ；
單季稅後淨利  2.08 億元 、EPS 1.27 元 ， 累計上半年營收 61.7 億
元（ YoY +15% ）、 EPS 1.93 元。改善動能來自  AI 高毛利產品
放量與稼動率回升，預估 AI（高速連接器＋高速傳輸線＋ Bloom 
Energy 電源線）營收占比由  1Q 的 14% 躍升至  2Q 的 20% 。

二、 AI 相關廠品高速連接器與電源線，切入美系大廠  
成長由高速連接器、高速傳輸線、 Bloom Energy （BE）大功率電
源線三大產品線構成，預估 2Q26 合計已占營收  20% ，為獲利結
構改善的核心。主力高速連接器最強：產品由過去硬碟、風扇、
記憶體等功能性小卡，逐步打入伺服器主機板與  CPU ／GPU ，並
已切入  CSP 大廠  AWS 、Meta 的 ASIC 伺服器。高速傳輸線：
已通過兩家  CSP 認證並於今年出貨 ； 惟因高度自製 、 每案規格不
同，逐季墊高，現階段聚焦機內線。 BE 大功率電源線 2H26 起放
量，隨其電廠模組化程度提升與新案推進，今年切入新案供應、
需求逐季提升並已規劃擴產；此塊沿用既有製造與工程能力、新
增資本與研發投入少，且毛利水準佳，隨  BE 新案放量，營收與
獲利貢獻將逐步提升。

三、預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 5.51/7.55 元 
AI 產品組合拉升，預估  2026 年 11.79 億元（ YoY +97.5% ）、
2027 年 16.37 億元（YoY +38.8% ）； 營業利益率同步由 2024 年 
2.9% 攀升至  2027 年  10.2% 。預估  2026 年營收  138.3 億元
（YoY +27.3% ）、 毛 利 率 26.4% 、稅後淨利  9.63 億元、EPS 5.51 
元； 2027 年營收  160.6 億元（ YoY +16.1% ）、毛利率  27.6% 、
稅後淨利  13.18 億元、 EPS 7.55 元。

四、投資建議：買進，目標價 136 元 
由傳統消費性連接器，轉向  AI 高速連接器、高速傳輸線與大功
率電源線，產品組合結構性升級，以過去正常獲利水準本益比約
在 12-18 倍 之 間，而 現 在 有AI 新題材成長 ， 屬於新一塊獲利貢獻，
給予 18 倍本益比，以 2027 EPS 計算，目標價 136 元，建議買進。

貳、公 司 概 況 
一、公司簡介  
宏致成立於  1996 年，總部位於台灣桃園，專注於高階精密連接
器與連接線的研發與製造，超過  5,000 名員工，橫跨亞洲、美洲
與歐洲建構完整製造與服務網絡。從設計、模具、沖壓、電鍍，
到組裝與測試的全方位製造服務，致力於成為全球客戶最信賴的
連接解決方案夥伴。全球擁有 6 大製造地區、 10 座生產工廠，遍
佈 11 國的全球業務服務據點 。 三大事業群 ： 連接器事業群 （ACES 
宏致）：專注於高速、高頻、高可靠性連接器的設計與製造，具備
模具 、 沖壓 、 電鍍及整合組裝能力 。 連接線事業群 （MEC 龍翰  ）：
專注於高速傳輸線材、模組與車用線束製造，支援多樣化應用需
求。金屬沖壓事業群（ KYN 廣迎新）：專注於全方位金屬結構件
製造，具備  NCT 數控沖孔加工機、雷射切割與折彎設備，涵蓋
各式金屬支架、電磁屏蔽罩、伺服器機殼、機箱機櫃等精密結構
件加工，並可延伸至  Level 3 機構組裝階段，實現整合方案一站
式供應。公司長期以來的併購形成不同應用別的完整布局，目前
連接器與連接線相關可分成五大產品應別：工業 (不斷電系統、智
能工業設備 、 工業電腦)、 一般網通相關(通用型伺服器 、 網路設備、
機上盒 )、AI 相關 (資料中心、高速連接 )、車用電子、電腦相關消
費性電子。

圖二、 AI 產品營收佔比持續提高

二、 AI 高速連接相關產品放量，帶動獲利成長  
宏致高速連接相關產品主要分為高速連接器與高速連接線。  
高速連接器由過去應用於硬碟、風扇、記憶體等功能性小卡，逐
步打入伺服器主機板及  CPU/GPU 相關應用，並已切入 CSP 大廠
AWS 和 Meta 的 ASIC 伺服器。 2025 年以前僅出小板； 2026 年隨
CSP 主導晶片設計，除了小板也開始供應主板， ASIC 以整機的量
去看待，主要產品為 MCIO ，有 20 幾種規格  宏致全規格出貨。
預估單機櫃高速連接器用量由過去  8~10 顆倍增至  20 顆以上；
ASIC 機種因宏致同時供應主板與小板，單櫃可達  30 顆。月產
能由去年約  200 萬顆逐步提升至今年底上看  500 萬 顆，提 升2.5
倍，可見需求大增，產能滿載，開始放量。  
高速傳輸線，宏致從裸線開始自製、規格自開，與市場多向外部
採購裸線再組裝的模式差異化。產品經  2024~2025 逾一年驗證，
已通過兩家  CSP 認證，今年開始出貨。由於高速傳輸線高度自製
化，每一家規格都不同，放量較連接器和緩， 1H26 僅占營收約  1
％，逐季墊高，不像高速連接器比重提升快速。另外，宏致產品
主要是機內線，外部機櫃間傳輸線與解決方案目前還在努力中。

圖三、高速連接器示意圖

三、高壓電源線獲 Bloom Energy 訂單， 2H26 開始放量  
Bloom Energy （BE）近年為加速電廠建置，逐步採用模組化電源
系統，透過標準化電源模組進行彈性組裝，可依實際電力需求調
整系統規模。整體架構可大致分為供電與配電兩大部分，其中供
電端涉及發電及高功率電力轉換，配電端則負責後續電力分配。
由於各電源模組之間需要高壓線束進行電力傳輸與連接，此外電
力轉換設備內部亦有線束需求，因此  BE 電廠模組化程度提升，
將同步帶動高壓、高功率線束的使用量。  
宏致過去即為  BE 菲律賓廠既有供應商，惟過往相關業務規模有
限。隨  BE 近年營運狀況改善，加上新電廠方案逐步推進，宏致
自今年開始切入新案供應，並預期後續需求將逐季提升。公司目
前已針對  BE 需求規劃擴產，顯示其對該客戶後續需求能見度已
有一定掌握。

BE 的供應鏈並非由單一廠商獨占，而是採取分散供應策略；目前
宏致則透過高功率線束切入供電端。由於高壓線束可直接應用於
電源模組間的電力傳輸， 以及電力轉換設備內部連接， BE 電廠建
置規模擴大將有望帶動相關線束需求同步成長。相較高速傳輸線
束需要投入較多研發資源，高功率線束主要沿用公司既有製造與
工程能力，因此新增資本及研發投入相對少。公司亦表示相關產
品具備不錯的毛利水準，若後續  BE 新案持續放量，營收與獲利
的貢獻將逐步提升。

1 
4966 譜瑞-KY(Parade)

報告日期： 2026/08/06 研 究 員：羅  金 鳳 (Sunny Lo)  
壹、投 資 建 議

一.2Q26 稅後 EPS 7.41 元，符合預期  
AI 強勁的需求，造成基板、 T-Glass 、封測、記憶體、 Flash 缺貨
漲價，但譜瑞的客戶並未因此而下修訂單量，加上 TTED 出貨量
優於原先預期，帶動譜瑞 2Q26 營收 42.49 億元， QoQ+6.45% ，
YoY+3.59% ，但因半導體後段封測大幅漲價，使譜瑞毛利率落在
區間下緣，為 40.2% ，稅後淨利 5.93 億元， QoQ+12.13% ，
YoY-15.51% ， 單季稅後EPS 7.41 元，合 計1H26 稅後 EPS 14.02
元。

二.季節性旺季及 TTED 續強 ， 帶動3Q26 營運優於預期  
由於 AI 強勁的需求帶動半導體及整個電子供應鏈零組件缺貨、漲
價，尤其 CPU 、Memory 的漲價最直接影響終端消費性電子產品
的需求，使 2H26 PC/NB 市場的需求疲弱，但譜瑞的客戶拉貨仍
在常軌上，不受原物料缺貨漲價的影響，加上譜瑞推出具有競爭
力的 TTED(T-CON + Source Driver + Touch) 的整合型產品受客
戶青睞， 2Q26 出貨量優於預期，預估 3Q26 將進一步成長，帶動
譜瑞 3Q26 營收表現優於預期；毛利率方面：因譜瑞將向客戶適
度反映封測漲價的成本，使譜瑞在來來幾季的毛利率將逐漸改
善。綜上，我們預估譜瑞 3Q26 營收 46.72 億元， QoQ+9.96% ，
YoY+6.7% ，毛利率 42.04% ，稅後淨利 7.1 億元，QoQ+19.65% ，
YoY-12.99% ，單季稅後 EPS 8.87 元。

三.ASIC-like 於 2H27 開始貢獻營收  
譜瑞持續利用自身擁有的 IP 及技術，延伸產品線廣度。近年持續
與國際大客戶進行新產品開發，利用自身擁有的高速傳輸介面 IP
開發 ASIC-like 產品，以獲取近年因 AI 興起帶動的 ASIC 開發商
機，ASIC-like 目前有數個專案在進行中，主要與高速傳輸相關的
系統性產品為主 ，2Q26 與客戶合作針對系統方面進行測試 ， 3Q26
有一顆晶片將進行 Tape-out ，預估下一顆也很快會進行
Tape-out ，2H27 開始貢獻營收。

四. 預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 31.66/39.37 元 
2026 年雖然記憶體價格飆漲將普遍影響全球 PC/NB 出貨量，但
譜瑞的客戶以高端產品為主，受到記憶體價格影響的程度低，並
未下修訂單預估數，且因 Intel 及 AMD 的 CPU 缺貨，部份客戶增

加 Qualcomm 的拉貨，有助譜瑞高傳輸出貨成長，因此，我們預
估譜瑞 2026 年營收 176.94 億元 ，YoY+7.03% ， 毛利率41.35% ，
稅後淨利 25.34 億元， YoY-7.06% ，稅後 EPS 31.66 元。2027 年
可望在 PC/NB 的需求方面看到溫和復甦及 ASIC-like 的營收貢
獻 ， 因此 ， 我們預估譜瑞2027 年營收 199.1 億元 ，YoY+12.52% ，
毛利率 42.83% ，稅後淨利 31.52 億元， YoY+24.37% ，稅後 EPS 
39.37 元。

五. 投資建議為買進，目標價 866 元 
譜瑞有多項新品包括 ACC 、ASIC-like 、AUTO 未來前景看好，整
合型的 TED 、TTED 也開始放量出貨，提升競爭力，加上主要客
戶 NB 出貨量受記憶體價格飆漲影響低，使譜瑞 2026 年營運維持
成長 ，2027 年 有 較 大 的 成 長，因 此，投 資 建 議 為 買 進，目 標 價866
元(22 X 2027 稅後 EPS) 。

貳、公 司 營 運 概 況

一.公司簡介  
譜瑞 -KY(4966) 成立於 2005 年，為顯示器、 NB、消費性電子產品
及顯示面板所使用之高速訊號傳輸介面標準之專業領導供應商，
為少數擁有自有 USB 4.0 及 DP IP 的公司，有利分食未來電子產
品高速傳輸及規格升級的商機，目前 DP 佔營收比重約 >30%、PS 
50% 、TC <10% 、TT( 含 TTED) 約 10% 。

二.營運概況及展望  
1、譜瑞高速傳輸地位逐漸上升 
譜瑞 2q26 年 PS 營收比重為 45% ，PS 包含 USB 、DP、HDMI 、
PCIe，其 中USB 的成長主要來自 CPU 的升級及平台協定的改變 ，
促使傳輸速度增加， USB 4 傳輸速度由 10G 上升至 20G ，甚至
40G 以及未來的 80G，帶動 Retimer 需求增加； DP 的部份，亦因
為 CPU 平台的升級 ，IC 由 DP 1.4 升級至 2.0， 傳輸速度將由32G
上升至 40G 或 80G， 亦有利譜瑞 ；HDMI 方 面，因 為NB 支援 HDMI
的滲透率逐漸增加， NB 亦逐漸技援 4K 或 8K，HDMI 2.0 將升級
至 2.1 ，但因 CPU 平台尚未支援 HDMI 2.1 的訊號，因此，若要
使用 HDMI 2.1 的訊號，則必須使用譜瑞的 Converter ，譜瑞在此
領䧕佔有主導地位，且主要 NB 品牌廠均為譜瑞客戶，有利譜瑞
營運成長。因譜瑞營運主要受惠平台升級，受 NB 產業起伏的影
響相對較低，未來 USB 及 HDMI 將為 PS 中成長最快速的產品，
且因高速傳輸進入門檻越來越高，譜瑞將為最大贏家，且預估未
來車用電子的 PS 需求亦可期待。

3 
由於電子產品傳輸速度不斷增加，提供譜瑞每年超過 10% 的營運
成長，未來高速傳輸介面產品仍扮演譜瑞營運成長動能重要角
色。過往 NB 功能及結構設計相對單純，內部元件之間的距離相
對較近，且資料傳輸速度較慢，因此僅需 Re-driver 做訊號的補強
即可，但隨著 NB 多元化及設計結構的複雜性提高，且為提供各
種不同的資料傳輸與應用 ， 譜瑞提供各種介面 ， 包括PCIe、USB、
SATA 、HDMI 等，且這些裝置與電腦之間的傳輸速度越來越快，
以 PCIe 為例，隨著每個世代的推進，傳輸速度從 8Gb →16bG →
32Gb →64G ，由於傳輸速度快速提升，將造成資料傳輸時產生訊
號衰減的問題，帶動 Retimer 需求大幅提升。為滿足各種不同介
面的傳輸品質穩定，譜瑞進行多種通訊協定的整合，可支援所有
傳輸速度的產品，亦成為譜瑞最佳競爭優勢。未來資料傳輸速度
不斷提升，使得高速傳輸將從以往高階頂規產品才有的配備變成
近乎標配的規格，因傳輸速度大於 10Gb 將產生嚴重訊號衰減問
題，必需進行訊號的修正，帶動 Re-Timer 需求持續成長，提供譜
瑞未來營運成長重要動能。且因高速傳輸介面產品的設計製造難
度大幅提升，自然形成產業的進入障礙，競爭者將較以往減少。

叁、業 績 及 獲 利 預 估

1、預估 3Q26 稅後 EPS 8.87 元 
譜瑞的客戶拉貨仍在常軌上，不受原物料缺貨漲價的影響，加上
譜瑞推出具有競爭力的 TTED(T-CON + Source Driver + Touch)
的整合型產品受客戶青睞， 2Q26 出貨量優於預期，因此，我們預
估譜瑞 3Q26 營收 46.72 億元， QoQ+9.96% ，YoY+6.7% ，毛利
率 42.04% ，稅後淨利 7.1 億元， QoQ+19.65% ，YoY-12.99% ，
單季稅後 EPS 8.87 元。

2、預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 31.66/39.37 元 
2026 年雖然記憶體價格飆漲將普遍影響全球 PC/NB 出貨量，但
譜瑞的客戶以高端產品為主，受到記憶體價格影響的程度低，並
未下修訂單預估數，且因 Intel 及 AMD 的 CPU 缺貨，部份客戶增
加 Qualcomm 的拉貨，有助譜瑞高傳輸出貨成長，因此，我們預
估譜瑞 2026 年營收 176.94 億元 ，YoY+7.03% ， 毛利率41.35% ，
稅後淨利 25.34 億元， YoY-7.06% ，稅後 EPS 31.66 元。2027 年
可望在 PC/NB 的需求方面看到溫和復甦及 ASIC-like 的營收貢
獻 ， 因此 ， 我們預估譜瑞2027 年營收 199.1 億元 ，YoY+12.52% ，
毛利率 42.83% ，稅後淨利 31.52 億元， YoY+24.37% ，稅後 EPS 
39.37 元。

個股報告 
環宇-KY(4991) 
基板供應改善帶動 AOC 出貨回升，2027 年接續放量 
投資評等 目標價 
逢低買進 $531 
前次投資建議：無

報告日期：2026.08.07 研 究 員：李彝安

摘 要 及 調 整 原 因 
➢ 磷化銦基板供應改善，AOC 出貨自下半年逐步恢復，毛利率沿季度回升，預估 2026 年 EPS 
5.88 元、2027年 8.16 元，給予目標價 531 元(65 x 2027(F)PER)，潛在上漲空間 20.1%，
評等為「逢低買進」。

基本資料 結論與建議 
2026/08/06 收盤價： 442.0 ➢ 26Q2 營收達到 7.70 億元（QoQ +7.8%、YoY 
+57.2%），產品組合轉差毛利率為 43.3%，較前季下
降 11.2 個百分點。上半年磷化銦基板及部分原料供應
受限，公司增加射頻晶圓代工產出以維持產能利用率，
但毛利率較高的主動光元件（Active Optical 
Components，AOC）出貨減少，營收占比由前季 74% 
降至 61%，加上存貨跌價及呆滯損失提列，造成整體
毛利率下滑。

➢ 基板供應自 6 月開始改善，AOC 出貨預計自 26Q3 
逐步恢復。目前取得的磷化銦基板供貨量可支應 2026 
年需求，但基板投入至產品出貨仍需一定生產週期，因
此 7 月 AOC 產出尚未完全恢復。研究部預估 26Q3 
毛利率回升至 45.5%，惟射頻在製品仍待消化，產品
組合短期內尚難回到 26Q1 水準。

➢ 預估 2026 年營收 33.70 億元（YoY +53.7%） 、毛利
率 48.0%、EPS 5.88 元；2027 年營收 43.90 億元
（YoY +30.0%） 、毛利率 51.2%、EPS 8.16 元。考量 
2027 年 AOC 出貨恢復、威力富 LD 開始貢獻，以及
毛利率隨產品組合改善，給予目標價 531 元(65 x 
2027(F)PER)，潛在上漲空間 20.1%。目前股價已反映
部分光通訊成長預期，故投資評等給予「逢低買進」 。

營 運 分 析 
以美國 GCS為核心，主攻光通訊與射頻製程之化合物半導體供應商 
環宇-KY 為化合物半導體晶圓代工廠，成立於  2010 年，於 2014 年掛牌
上櫃，核心營運子公司 Global Communication Semiconductors（GCS）位
於美國加州，主攻砷化鎵、磷化銦、氮化鎵及碳化矽高階射頻與光電元件之
化合物半導體代工，並自主經營品牌光通訊元件（AOC）業務。公司產品線
分為三塊：射頻晶圓代工，應用於手機功率放大器與通訊；光電晶圓代工，
承接外部客戶之光電元件製程；以及自有品牌 AOC，涵蓋磷化銦光偵測器
（PD）與連續波雷射（CW Laser）等光通訊主動元件，直接切入 AI 資料
中心光模組供應鏈。 
環宇與同業的差異化在於磷化銦光電，並具備美國在地晶圓製造產能，此一
產能配置在美中光通訊供應鏈重組下形成相對優勢。客戶端，公司將射頻與
光電合併聚焦於 5 至 6 個核心客戶，最大單一客戶為中系光模組廠，同時
供貨 Lumentum、Coherent、AAOI 等非中系業者。公司並於 2026 年 4 月
完成對威力富科技 60.05% 股權投資並納入合併，威力富自 26Q3 起貢獻 
PD 產出，2027 年以雷射二極體（LD）為主力產品，作為外部產能與產品
組合的延伸。 
圖一、環宇-KY(4991) 2026Q2產品別營收比重

- 3 - 
個股報告

磷化銦基板供應受限，26Q2 產品組合轉差壓低毛利率 
26Q2 營收 7.70 億元（QoQ +7.8%、YoY +57.2%） ，毛利率 43.3%，較前
季下降 11.2 個百分點、較去年同期下降 9.9 個百分點，主要來自產品組合
改變；營業利益率 12.8%，EPS 0.91 元。 
上半年磷化銦基板及部分 AOC 原料供應不足，限制高毛利光通訊產品的生
產，公司因而 提高射頻晶圓代工產出。 26Q2 射頻晶圓代工營收  QoQ 
+118%，AOC 營收則 QoQ -11%，使 AOC 營收占比由 26Q1 的 74% 降
至 61%。 
由於射頻晶圓代工毛利率低於  AOC，營收占比提高後直接稀釋整體毛利
率。此外，公司依存貨成本及市價重新評估部分射頻晶圓，認列跌價及呆滯
損失，亦對單季毛利造成影響。研究部預估 26Q2 為 2026 年毛利率低點，
後續 AOC 產出恢復及射頻在製品去化毛利將逐季改善。

基板供應自 6 月改善，AOC 出貨自 26Q3 逐步恢復 
由於基板自放量到出貨仍有前置時間，AOC 產出於 7 月下旬起陸續回補，
AOC 營收占比隨之回升，帶動  26Q3 毛利率回升至  45.5%（ QoQ 
+2.2ppt） 。惟 7 月 AOC 產出仍未完全解除限制，且帳上大量在製射頻晶
圓須先消化 ，26Q3仍無法回到 26Q1 時 AOC 占比約 75%、 毛利率 54.5% 
的高毛利結構。展望 2027 年，隨基板供應穩定、AOC 產出恢復及新產品
占比提高，研究部預估毛利率由 2026 年的 48.0%提升至 51.2%。不過，
公司下半年規劃增購約 1,600 萬美元設備，新增折舊將抵銷部分產品組合改
善效益，因此毛利率回升速度仍需觀察實際產能利用率。

光通訊供不應求下產能為主要瓶頸，200G PD與 CW 雷射為 2027主軸 
AI 資料中心 200G 與 1.6T 光模組需求拉動磷化銦 PD 與 CW 雷射，市
場供不應求，目前訂單能見度已看至年底，短期出貨限制主要來自基板、設
備及製程產能，而非終端訂單不足產品端。產品方面，200G PD 已進入量
產，並受惠單通道傳輸速率提升及 800G、1.6T 光模組升級。CW Laser 方
面，70mW 產品已通過多家客戶驗證並開始小量出貨，公司亦 持續進行  
100mW 產品的可靠度測試。轉投資威力富自 26Q3 起以 PD 貢獻產出，
2027 年 LD 放量後成為外部產能主要來源，支撐  2027 年營收  YoY 
+30%。公司有提到 1.6T 需求不如市場預期樂觀，部分客戶因缺乏 DSP 或 
EML 而改採 100G PD 方案，使 800G 之成長確定性高於 1.6T；EML 方
面公司僅承接客戶代工，自有產品聚焦 CW 雷射，不投入 EML。 
原料供應方面，公司目前磷化銦基板仍以 AXT 為主要供應商，但已逐步增
加非中國來源，部分  200G 產品已採用非中國供應鏈，並規劃於  2027 年
提高日本供應商採購比重。雖有助降低單一地區供應風險，但非中國基板成
本可能較高，後續仍須透過售價調整及產品組合改善吸收。

個股報告 
一次性投資利益墊高 2026 年 EPS，2027 年獲利較能反映本業變化 
公司於 26Q1 認列約 1.40 億元處分投資利益，約當 EPS 0.9 元，屬一次
性項目。研究部預估 2026 年 EPS 5.88 元已包含此項收益，扣除一次性利
益後，本業 EPS 約為 5 元。 
轉投資方面，常州承芯自 26Q1 起因公司不再具重大影響力，改列透過其他
綜合損益按公允價值衡量之金融資產 （FVOCI） ，後續評價變動將計入其他綜
合損益，不再影響當期 EPS。權益法投資收益目前主要來自持股 48%的上
海宙鎵，1H26 約貢獻 4,300 萬元。 
威力富納入合併後，2026 年仍處於產能建置及產品放量初期，預估短期尚
未轉盈；待 2027 年 LD 出貨增加並轉為獲利後，部分獲利亦將歸屬非控制
權益。 
圖二、環宇-KY (4991)各季營收及獲利走勢預估

資料來源：Cmoney；兆豐投顧預估 
研究部預估環宇 -KY 2026 ／2027 年 EPS 分別為 5.88／8.16 元。考量  
2026 年 EPS 包含約 0.9 元一次性處分投資利益，2027 年獲利較能反映 
AOC 出貨恢復、200G PD 與 CW Laser 成長，以及威力富 LD 開始貢獻
後的本業表現，因此採用 2027 年 EPS 作為評價基準。考量公司正處於 AI 
光通訊產品放量及獲利結構改善階段，並具美國在地製造布局，給予目標價 
531元(65 x 2027(F)PER)，潛在上漲空間為 20.1%。

6 月商務部通過的基板將於 26Q3 陸續到貨，因此可預期 AOC 營
收將重回動能，然而全球 1.6T 相關元件短缺，導致市場收發模組
實際供給量低於年初預期。環宇 200G PD 出貨進程及數量低於研
究部原先預估， CW laser 步調也略為落後，因此研究部下修
2026/2027 年營運展望。綜合以上，研究部預估環宇2026 年 EPS 
5.61 元，2027 年 EPS 22.86 元，目前 PE 為 21.7x，雖然產業供
給緊張程度高於原先預期， 導致短期整體市場增速低於預期， 但仍
持續看好光收發模組在近年為主要光傳輸主流技術 ， 因此略為下修
PER 至 27x，目標價 600 元，建議逢低布局。 
⚫ 公司基本資料 ⚫ 公司基本資料 
環宇-KY(4991)成立於 2010 年，資本額 12.1 億元。產品主要包含
PD、RF、晶圓代工，2025 年產品組合為 RF 18%、AOC 69%、
晶圓代工 10%、 其他3%。 上游磊晶片主要來自於全新光電(2455)，
下游則交由光收發模組廠。在 800G 光收發模組市場中，環宇的
100G PD 市佔率超過 70%，並預計於 2026 年開始交付 200G PD
以及切入發射端(LD)市場。

⚫ 近期報酬率(%) ⚫ 營運概況 
AOC 因基板短缺影響出貨，產品組合轉差拖累毛利率 
環宇 26Q2 營收 7.7 億元，Q+7.8%，Y+57.2%，毛利率 43.27%，
稅後淨利 1.1 億元，Q-43.8%，Y+672.0%，EPS 0.92 元。公司先
前已預告因為 InP 基板受中國出口限制， AOC 營收佔比下滑至
61%，Q-13ppts，Y-2ppts， 另外低毛利RF 產品佔比提升至 23%，
Q+11ppts，Y-1ppts，導致毛利率顯著下滑，業外權益法方面則隨
著常州承芯不再認列損益，僅剩上海宙鎵貢獻獲利約 1951 萬。

基板緊張暫為緩解，AOC 動能回升 
隨著 6 月基板通過商務部審查開始陸續到貨 ， 環宇預期7 月起 AOC
出貨將恢復過往成長動能，然而仍有高於公司原先預期規模的 RF
仍在產線上，公司預計毛利率表現雖然有所回升但仍會低於 26Q1
表現。基板短缺影響和 200G PD 放量時間點低於研究部原先預
期，此外 RF 仍高於原先看法，因此研究部下修後市營運表現，綜
合以上，預估環宇26Q3 營收 8.9 億元，Q+15.7%，Y+64.0%，毛
利率 45.48%， 稅後淨利1.5 億元 ，Q+33.6%，Y+917.3%，EPS 1.12
元。

持續看好高速光收發模組近年增速，然缺料問題短期未能緩解 
光收發模組仍將作為近兩年 Scale out 的主流光傳輸技術，然而不
僅上游雷射的短缺，InP 基板更面臨國際政治風險的衝擊導致非中
廠商受到供給衝擊，另一方面，美系大廠的 DSP 晶片、光隔離器
也同樣遭遇供不應求的事態，導致實際 800G/1.6T 光收發模組供
給量無法完全滿足市場需求，且此一情況短期內尚難有所緩解，導
致今年 1.6T 實際供給量可能會低於原先預期 。 環宇200G PD 產品
出貨進度暫時慢於研究部原先預期 ， 考量受大環境影響 ， 整體1.6T
光收發模組市場規模下修，研究部因此下調環宇 2026/2027 年營

預估 2H26 優於 1H26，調高全年營收預估 YoY 至>5 成 
2Q26 營收季增 48%，優於預期，主要來自美國 P2 廠務工程完工認列進度
加速、後段封測設備銷售強勁等。毛利率季持平達 13.4%，優於先前預估季
增 0.9 個百分點，雖然廠務工程營收季增 8 成及佔比提高至 6 成，但來自廠
務本身的獲利結構亦有明顯改善 ，加上業外淨收益 3.2 億挹注，本季 EPS 
8.2 元/季增 62%，優於市場/元大預期 41%/34%。預估 3Q26 營收季增 3%、
EPS 7.86 元/季減 4%。推估 2026 全年營收年增 5 成，優於先前預估的 4 成。   
主力客戶美國建廠計劃能見度至 2028 年 
2Q26 營收結構分別為 OEM 客製化設備 15%、代理材料 24%、自動化供應
系統 39%、廠務工程系統整合 23%，其中以廠務工程、先進封裝相關業務
成長皆>5 成。先進封裝相關業務尤其看好 AIM Bonder/ De -Bonder 設備成
長潛力，估計 26 年營收佔比達 10%，訂單能見度至 27 年。2Q26 美國廠務
營收佔比估計約 2~3 成、毛利率>10%，歷經 P1 學習曲線，有助工程效率
提升及獲利結構改善。美國 P2 預計 2H26 完工，估計 2026 年完工比例認列
營收>5 成。美國 P3、AP 陸續於 2Q~3Q26 發包，效益落在 2027~28 年。

產業概況  
先進製程與供應鏈在地化為大勢所趨 
自疫情後各國積極推動半導體供應鏈在地化，美國、歐洲、日本相繼祭出補貼以吸引先進製程及先
進封裝投資，使全球新廠與擴產計畫明顯增加，帶動設備與廠務族群自  2023 年起營收與市值持續
成長。 展望 2026 年，本中心預期設備與廠務族群仍將延續成長趨勢，主因包含 1)  AI 、HPC 需求
持續快速成長、先進製程產能加速放量 ; 2) 主要半導體製造商資本支出擴增、台積電美國建廠將於
2026 年加速，WFE (Wafer Fab Equipment) 將成長 9%。預估 2026 年主要晶圓廠資本支出達
1,792 億美元(YoY+37%)，其中台積電及海力士之資本支出年增分別為 51%/19%，反映 AI 帶動先
進製程/HBM 相關設備需求強勁，將進一步推動廠務與設備需求加速成長。

2026~2027 年半導體設備支出持續創新高 
根據 SEMI 預估 2026/2027 年 WFE 成長 9/7%，其中 Memory 主要受到記憶體廠稼動率回升及 AI
帶動 HBM 需求強勁，Logic 除了 AI 相關投資以外，多數仍在消耗先前過剩產能為主，展望 2026
年景氣全面復甦、AI 持續擴大、新建廠效應，WFE 將進一步成長 9%，反映 AI 帶動先進製程/HBM
相關設備需求強勁，成熟製程方面，台積電也於 2026/7/16 表示海外成熟製程中以 PMIC 與 CMOS
需求較強，顯示未來成熟製程也仍有溫和成長的趨勢。

受惠台積電全球擴產與 AI 需求，廠務工程供應鏈在手訂單維持歷史高檔 
2026～2030 年，台積電在台灣與美國同步加速先進製程及先進封裝擴產。美國亞利桑那 Fab 1 已
於 2024 年第 4 季以 N4 製程量產；Fab 2 廠房結構於 2025 年完成，目標於 2027 年下半年量產 N3；
Fab 3 則已於 2025 年 4 月動工，規劃導入 N2/A16，並以本十年末量產為目標。台積電於 2026 年
7 月 16 日再宣布加碼 1,000 億美元，使美國總投資規模提高至 2,650 億美元，後續將增建更多 2
奈米以下晶圓廠與先進封裝設施。 
台灣方面，新竹與高雄 2nm、台南 3nm 及先進封裝產能持續擴張；台積電最新表示，目前在台灣
正興建 13 座領先的先進封裝廠。海外方面，德國德勒斯登 ESMC 已於 2024 年動工，日本熊本二
廠則持續推進，但製程規格與投產時程仍依客戶需求及政策支持調整，台積電亦正在評估於熊本導
入 3 奈米製程。 
半導體廠務工程通常跨越數季至數年，營收依履約或完工進度分期認列 ；海外專案另受許可、在地
法規、驗證、人力與供應鏈配置影響，交付與認列節奏通常較台灣更長。目前四家主要供應商最新
可得在手訂單分別為漢唐 1,939 億元、帆宣逾 1,350 億元、亞翔 1,754 億元及聖暉*550 億元，整體
訂單能見度維持高檔，其中以台積電先進製程、先進封裝及海外建廠供應鏈最直接受惠。

長動能，能見度長達 2027~28 年；3) 美國廠學習曲線提升下長期獲利將持續改善，本次 報告維持
目標價 650 元不變，換算 27 年目標本益比由先前 25 倍降至 21 倍，反映近期評價面受到系統性風
險、籌碼面而有所下修 ，然而短期營運表現優於預期、公司目前在手訂單能見度長達 2027~28 年、
美國子公司獲利大幅改善、主力客戶展望佳且積極擴大海外資本支出等，對基本面看法不變。

公司簡介  
帆宣科技成立於 1988 年，專注於半導體、平面顯示器設備及耗材代理、廠務系統 TURNKEY 服務等業務，公司於湖口、
頭份、善化及台南科學園區設立工廠，投入客製化設備之組裝製造，目前擁有多項專利，進一步將公司營業範疇自代理、
廠務系統擴大至開發客製化產品。公司主要分為四大事業群，包括高科技設備 (代理)、自動化、廠務工程及客製化製造。無
塵室與機電系統整合工程服務介於工程業主與工程材料、設備及工程分包商間，針對業主需求，提供客戶整廠機電、無塵
室統包工程承攬服務等工程服務。

ESG 分析  
分別藉由「在 ESG 議題上的曝險」和「個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力」兩個面向來衡量公司於 ESG 上的表現。 
► ESG 總分： 帆宣整體的 ESG 風險評級屬於中風險，於 Sustainalytics 資料庫所覆蓋的公司中排行於略微領先的位置，
但在半導體設備行業中排名略微領先同業。 
► 在 ESG 議題上的曝險： 帆宣的整體曝險屬於低等水準，但略低於半導體設備行業的平均水準。公司較需要改善的  ESG 
議題包含人力資本、商業道德及資源使用等。 
► 個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力：帆宣在針對重大 ESG 議題的管理水準和執行力屬中等。崇越於 ESG 相關揭露程度
高，顯示其對投資人及大眾的責任感極佳，雖說公司有針對重大 ESG 議題進行管控，但對於關鍵領域仍缺乏相關政策
及計畫。然而，目前崇越尚未涉及任何 ESG 重大爭議。

量進程明確，公司在主動對位技術與PIC組裝的高度經驗與良率
改善，不僅支撐2026年高速成長，更著眼未來巨型資料中心分散
化趨勢下 ， 伺服器叢集間跨中心互聯(Scale-across)拓撲架構對光
模組數量的激增需求，並與長年合作的北美指標客戶並肩進入
1.6T及相關RW元件切削檢驗之量產升級；在高功率半導體與先
進載板領域，AI 伺服器機架內部因為空間與垂直供電效率極限，
使得電源密度標準嚴格 ， 同欣電於氮化鎵與碳化矽等第三類半導體
模組驗證推進順利，預期於2026年底至2027年起進入實質量產

一，現已廣泛應用於：無線通訊、MEMS、 影像感測器、光電半導體
元件、LED、太陽能電池、汽車電子、電腦周邊零組件、醫療與網路設
備等領域。此外，同欣還提供影像感測器、MEMS及生醫檢測產品所

大股東持股合計28.6%。國內主要封測廠同業為日月光投控
(3711.TT)、京元電子(2449.TT)、頎邦科技(6147.TT)等。

季節性需求回歸與光通訊續強，第三季營運穩步向上 
展望第三季營運，管理層表示今年營運模式已正式回歸疫情前的正常季
節性軌道，即逐季增長的穩健態勢，並指引3Q26營收將呈中個位數百
分比成長。在各產品線展望與動能依據上，RF模組仍是最具把握的主
力引擎，隨著北美CSP客戶對800G光模組之需求持續擴大，公司第
二台自動化對位設備即將到位，將有助於生產良率與出貨規模進一步躍
升；陶瓷電路板與影像感測器線則預期將維持正向成長，其中陶瓷基板
受惠於雷射散熱底座需求及車用市場的基本盤支撐；唯混合積體電路模
組將受傳統燃油車用壓力感測器出貨疲軟影響而持續偏弱。值得注意的
是，經營團隊觀察到光通訊模組與高單價產品之良率改善效益，將長期
的毛利率指引區間由過去的25%~30%，向上提升至30%~35%區間，

400G僅著墨電性組裝，800G封裝製程需額外整合光學元件(PIC)並配
合精密主動對位與UV固化製程，大幅提升產品單價與封裝價值，同時
公司亦與客戶密切研發次世代1.6T光收發器產品，將DSP直接整合於
載板，蓄積後續爆發動能；陶瓷電路板線則受惠於兩大核心動能而穩健
揚升，其一為AI資料中心高速傳輸帶動高功率(230W)雷射封裝(CoS)
基板出貨急增，成功取代過往日商供應份額；其二為切入混合動力車
(HEV)應用的AMB活性金屬釺焊基板逐步量產；影像感測器(CIS)則受
惠於中國大陸車市客戶為符合外銷出口之嚴格車規可靠度標準，擴大對
iBGA高階封裝方案的需求，驅動車用前視與環視感測模組市佔率穩健
成長。混合積體電路模組由於燃油車用壓力感測器面臨結構性衰退，為
今年唯一微幅退縮之分項，然其佔公司整體營收比重已進一步收斂，對
毛利的負面拖累係已顯著鈍化。綜合以上，研究部預估同欣電
(6271.TT)2026年營業收入為128.73億元，Y+11.51%、毛利率
30.63%，Y+3.03ppt、營業利益率17.69%，Y+3.77ppt、稅後純益
21.84億元，Y+36.72%、EPS為10.45元。

光收發模組規格持續提升 
隨著資料中心的快速發展，同欣電在光通訊領域持續投入佈局，主力產
品著重於資料中心間連結(Scale-across)的長距離傳輸，其中800G產
品已於2025年12月開始出貨。相較於400G產品，800G因需將光纖
組合單元(FAU)固定於光IC側邊並點上UV膠，取得製程內容提升將帶
動ASP顯著提升，是2026年成長主因，而未來佈局1.6T產品目前已
有部分零件完成試產並送樣，取得製程內容再近一步升級，需將DSP
直接封裝於ABF基板上，將有效帶動ASP提升。另一方面，針對AI
高階晶片封裝需求，同欣電正積極評估以陶瓷基板取代現有ABF基板
(BT core)的解決方案，目前聚焦於ZTA(氧化鋯鋁氮化物)與氮化矽兩種
材質，以解決多層ABF壓合後可能產生的板翹效應，目前大量生產的
陶瓷基板主流尺寸為138x190mm，公司正與板廠合作，透過拼接技術
開發510x515mm的大尺寸解決方案，此外，同欣電亦積極投入第三類
半導體(HVDC)領域，碳化矽(SiC)的離散元件(Discrete)與模組均已通過
認證並逐步生產，未來有望導入資料中心的800V架構；同時氮化鎵
(GaN)也正如火如荼研發中，預計將用於資料中心Rack內的電源供應
系統(Power supply)，有望於2027年前進入生產。

產業分析-記憶體產業 
晶圓鍵合與高密度 QLC 開啟 3D NAND 下一個階段 
What’s New –  高層數 NAND 進入架構整合競賽 
3D NAND競爭已由單純堆高層數，轉向結構、製程、電路與控制器的整合優化。SK hynix先
以 321層 NAND導入三段通孔，藉以降低高深寬比蝕刻與通道孔對位難度，後續 QLC再採六
平面及 32顆裸晶封裝，提升資料傳輸、讀寫效能與功耗效率。Kioxia/SanDisk的 332層 2Tb 
QLC則結合 CMOS 直接鍵合、一排六平面、專用金屬配線與電源雜訊管理，將位元密度提升
至37.6Gb/mm²。Samsung V10 BV-NAND進一步以晶圓鍵合推進至 400層以上，顯示高層
數 NAND的競爭核心已由層數競賽，轉向鍵合、橫向微縮與 QLC可用容量的協同設計。 
Trends/Outlook – 通道孔蝕刻將成為 3D NAND 的瓶頸  
未來 3D NAND 每 GB成本將由完成晶圓成本、良品裸晶數與有效可售容量共同決定，層數增
加若伴隨高深寬比蝕刻、沉積均勻性、多段堆疊或鍵合良率惡化，成本下降將顯著趨緩。通道
孔蝕刻與垂直間距微縮是高層數 NAND的核心瓶頸，晶圓鍵合雖可分別最佳化周邊 CMOS與
記憶體陣列、縮短訊號路徑並提高有效面積，但亦增加平坦度、對位與整合良率挑戰。QLC較
TLC 增加 33%原始位元容量，惟 16 個臨界電壓狀態使錯誤校正、軟判讀、控制器與企業級
SSD架構更為關鍵。SK hynix與 Kioxia均將 QLC推進至六個獨立操作平面，透過更多可獨立
運作的單元補償大容量裸晶寫入延遲。未來競爭將邁入結構、材料與演算法共同微縮階段。 
Investment Summary 
1. 3D NAND 正由持續堆高層數、壓低單位成本，轉向以晶圓鍵合、高密度 QLC 與控制器韌
體，將低成本位元轉化為可用的企業級儲存容量。SK hynix 已開始供應 321 層 QLC 企業級
SSD，Kioxia/SanDisk亦揭示 332層、2Tb QLC技術並朝商業化推進；新世代 NAND的價值
將更集中於錯誤校正、讀取校正、快閃轉譯層、服務品質與資料保護能力。因此，最直接受惠
者並非所有記憶體模組廠，而是具備控制器、韌體與企業級 SSD整合能力的業者。  
2. 台廠方面，看好群聯(8299 TT)。群聯產品涵蓋 NAND 控制器、韌體、客製化儲存方案與
PASCARI企業級 SSD，並非單純模組銷售。隨高層數 QLC導入資料中心，較窄的儲存電壓區
間、寫入放大、耐用度與延遲一致性問題，將提升控制器與韌體技術含量。 宜鼎(5289 TT)則
屬於偏系統端的受惠標的，已布局 PCIe Gen5、最高 128TB 的 QLC 企業級 E3.L SSD，若資料
中心與邊緣運算客戶加速採用高容量 SSD，將有利其由工控儲存延伸至企業級應用。
